evidence:
REAL GATE IN GATE DIMENSIONS. tests/scoring.toml lists render and constraints under [gates]; both gate judge.toml files use aggregation = "all_pass" with binary criteria; tests/test.sh lines 213-221 run the gates suite first and exit before the scored suite when score.py reports a gate failure. gates/render/prompt.md line 5: "A blank page, a generic error, an unavailable server, or a static shell whose editor cannot be typed into fails." Its single criterion cw_workspace_loads_and_takes_typing (gates/render/judge.toml line 23) requires load, real typing visible in the editor, and a successful reload. Server backing (the app has a shared library, no sign-in per app_context.md line 10) is carried by the constraints gate criterion cw_shared_saved_record (gates/constraints/judge.toml line 32): save through the UI, clear this origin's browser storage, reload, read back exact title, filename and source, reload again. That is a real successful operation with a storage-independent readback, as REVIEW_POLICY 'Gates must exclude convincing dead apps' asks, not a health ping.

IN-DIMENSION GATE IN EVERY SCORED PROMPT. scored/functional/prompt.md line 5, scored/polish/prompt.md line 5 and scored/visual/prompt.md line 5 carry the identical paragraph: "Global browser gate: before scoring, confirm in the live browser that the application loads from http://localhost:3000 without a fatal browser error and that text typed into the code editor appears in it. External font, script or CDN asset requests are allowed. If the gate fails, assign 0 to every criterion in this dimension. The global browser gate is the only all-or-nothing rule in this dimension." This hard-zeros (no partial credit) and is stricter than the frozen template's gate, which only requires loading plus sign-in when sign-in exists; the typing leg is what excludes a static shell. visual/prompt.md line 9 keeps the zeroing consistent with the anchored scale: "Apart from a failed global browser gate, 0 is used only when the thing being judged is not shown at all." No auth leg is needed because the app has no sign-in.

NO SAME-ORIGIN REQUIREMENT. All five prompts state that external font, script or CDN asset requests are allowed; app_context.md line 32 repeats it. A grep of tests/**/*.md and *.toml for same-origin/cross-origin finds no gate wording; the only 'origin' hits in gate files are 'this origin's browser storage' (storage clearing scope) which does not constrain where assets load from.

COUNTEREXAMPLE ATTEMPTS. Broken apps: (a) blank page or crashed server fails render and every scored gate; (b) static HTML mock with a non-interactive code picture fails the typing leg in all five places; (c) typable editor with localStorage-only saves passes render but fails cw_shared_saved_record after storage clearing, so reward is 0; (d) textarea or CodeMirror wrapper fails cw_custom_document_surface. Conforming alternatives: a canvas-drawn editor can still show the typed word (app_context.md line 29 tells the judge to read text from screenshots); an app that raises a beforeunload dialog on reload is covered by the render criterion ("a reload that waits for that dialog is not a failure") and app_context.md line 23; an app loading fonts or libraries from a CDN is explicitly allowed. I found no conforming app that the gate wording would zero.

RUNTIME EVIDENCE. Scripted golden results on these bytes report cw_workspace_loads_and_takes_typing true (results/runtime.json), cw_custom_document_surface true (results/polish.json) and cw_shared_saved_record true (results/persist-before.json). These are scripted Playwright checks, not a configured judge run. The only hosted judge run is on an earlier candidate (render gate then required Run; it has since been reduced to load-and-type), so no configured judge has executed the current gate wording; that is recorded as a note, not as a waiver, and does not by itself change this row's source-determinable verdict.

NOTES (not defects). (1) The scored in-dimension gate restates load and typing but not the server-backing leg; the workbook says 'plus auth/backing checks when the app has them'. The frozen template's scored gate also has no backing leg, backing is hard-gated by cw_shared_saved_record before the scored suite can run, and adding a save-and-clear-storage step to each scored session would add workload and library records, so I do not treat this as a defect. (2) The render gate adds a reload leg that the scored in-dimension gate does not repeat; harmless asymmetry. (3) Workbook Internal sheet wording for check 29 still says 'cross-origin apps'; the public sheet's current wording ('must NOT require same-origin') governs and the task follows it.
